date_profile.format_decision: Day-month-year is used because it parses every supplied date, including day values above 12. Month-first parsing leaves those dates invalid.

variance_decomposition.note: Order ID year R² is a diagnostic of the date artifact. That identifier is not used as a model feature.

warnings.message: Ship dates parse as day-month-year (%d-%m-%Y), and 10,194 of 10,194 lead times exceed 365 days (range 904–1642). This may be a source-system offset, synthetic data, or a real delay. It is flagged, not deleted, and it is not treated as a credible delivery ETA.
10,194 rows have an Order ID year that does not match the order-date year. The Order ID year lines up with the multi-year lead-time bands. It is an identifier, not a model feature.

The order extract has no usable origin-factory field. Current factory is joined from the supplied product mapping and is an assumption, not an observed shipment fact. The model must not invent a factory effect by swapping labels.

Customer latitude and longitude are not in the extract. Great-circle distance runs only when the user supplies coordinates or explicitly accepts approximate state centroids. Straight-line distance is not road distance.
Freight charges, carrier rates, and factory-specific operating costs are not in the extract. Profit impact of a reassignment is not quantified unless the user enters a labeled sensitivity assumption.
10,194 lead times exceed 60 days, the business review threshold for a ship-date target. Rows are retained.
2,064 rows use a product name whose spacing differs from the supplied mapping (Wonka Bar -Scrumdiddlyumptious). Names are joined on a normalized key and the source spelling is preserved.
Division does not match the supplied mapping for: Fizzy Lifting Drinks: extract Sugar, mapping Other. Observed division is kept.
449 United States postal codes have 4 characters. Northeast codes may have lost a leading zero in the source extract. Postal code is stored as text and is not a model feature.
200 Canadian postal values are 3 characters or shorter and look truncated.
313 rows repeat the same order, dates, ship mode, city, product, sales, and units. They are retained so sample sizes are not silently reduced. Row ID itself is unique.
Gross Profit matches Sales minus Cost within one cent on every row. Source values were not rewritten.
0 lead times fall outside the 1.5 IQR fence. A multi-year shift that affects most rows is not an IQR outlier, so the business rule is reported separately.
